stem:
Rakesh chooses materials for heating water and for a handle on a hot copper pot. He may use copper, wood, or shiny plastic.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: A copper vessel is suitable for heating water because copper conducts heat well.
A wooden handle is safer on a hot copper pot because wood is a poor heat conductor.
A copper handle is safer than a wooden handle on the hot copper pot.
Shiny plastic is suitable for a heating vessel because it looks like metal and conducts heat well.

teacher.key_rationale: Good heating vessels need materials that conduct heat well, such as copper. Safe handles need poor conductors such as wood. Copper as a handle is unsafe; shiny look alone does not make plastic a good heating vessel.
